name: 2D Gradient Estimation for Shading
definition: Estimates surface normals from a depth image (distance from view plane to surface) using 2D central differences, allowing post-processing shading without recomputing the volume render.
summary: 2D Gradient Estimation for Shading computes surface normals from depth images to enable post-processing illumination, offering a computationally cheaper alternative to 3D methods despite susceptibility to artifacts at disjoint regions.
